title: Cartwise Shopper Batches Not-Delivered Standing Share by Violation Points
content:
When pay for orders verified as not delivered is taken back on a Cartwise Shopper Batches batch, the not-delivered standing share multiplies the not-delivered orders' share of the batch's mileage posting. It follows the active violation points on the shopper's Cartwise Shopper Contractor Accounts record:

| Active violation points | Not-delivered standing share |
|---|---|
| One to three | 0.80 |
| None | 0.60 |
| Four or more | 1.00 |

## Notes

- The points are the account's active violation points balance at the time of handling.
- The share is not ordered by the number of points: an account with no points has the lowest share (0.60), an account with one to three points 0.80, and an account with four or more the full 1.00.

## Hypothetical figures

| Not-delivered share of the mileage posting | Active points | After the standing share |
|---|---|---|
| 2.50 | 0 | 2.50 multiplied by 0.60 is 1.50 |
| 2.50 | 3 | 2.50 multiplied by 0.80 is 2.00 |
| 2.50 | 4 | 2.50 |
